## Summary

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and authorized milestone scope.

## Linked issue

Reference the relevant issue and requirement/decision IDs.

## Files changed

List the meaningful areas and why they changed.

## Test evidence

Record exact commands, actual results, failures and reproducibility details. Distinguish executed checks from planned checks.

## Simulation / physical-data status

Identify DOCUMENTED / SIMULATED / CODE-TESTED / HARDWARE-TESTED / FIELD-VALIDATED / UNKNOWN for claims. Include acquisition context, config/seed/run and ground-truth separation where relevant. Never imply hardware validation from software checks.

## Security considerations

Describe authorization/privacy/secret/upload/dependency impact; do not include sensitive data. Confirm the staged diff was reviewed.

## Remaining limitations

State unresolved choices, observable coverage, failures, follow-up and whether requirements/decisions/evidence docs changed.
